issues.description: Class name mismatch for the meal entity: the problem statement (and the reference solution) describe and use a class named Meal with a constructor Meal(String, String[]) and getters, but the template repository does not contain an implementation of Meal (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java is empty). Instead the template contains a class named Order (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Order.java) that has the same fields and accessors that Meal is expected to provide. This naming inconsistency (Meal vs Order) will confuse students and prevent them from following the specification/tests that expect a Meal class (missing Meal can also cause compilation/test failures when tests or instructions refer to Meal).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template and problem statement consistent: provide a Meal class in the template that matches the problem specification and the solution (a public class Meal with constructor Meal(String, String[]) and the relevant getters). Concretely either (a) rename the template's Order.java to Meal.java (or copy its implementation into a new Meal.java) and update any references in Main or other starter files, or (b) keep Order but update the problem statement/tests to reference Order everywhere. Preferred: add/replace Meal.java in the template with the same implementation shown in the solution and remove or rename Order.java so all artifacts consistently refer to Meal.
